title: Could Solar Storms Destroy Civilization? Solar Flares & Coronal Mass Ejections
speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】太陽風暴會摧毀文明嗎？太陽耀斑和日冕物質拋射（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: The Sun, smooth and round and peaceful.
cues.en: The Sun, smooth and round and peaceful.
cues.zh: 太陽 圓滑且和平

cues.text: Except when it suddenly vomits radiation and plasma in random directions.
cues.en: Except when it suddenly vomits radiation and plasma in random directions.
cues.zh: 除非它突然在隨機方向上釋放出輻射和電漿體。

cues.text: These solar flares and coronal mass ejections, or CMEs,
cues.en: These solar flares and coronal mass ejections, or CMEs,
cues.zh: 這些太陽的耀斑和日冕物質拋射出CME

cues.text: can hit Earth and have serious consequences for humanity.
cues.en: can hit Earth and have serious consequences for humanity.
cues.zh: 會撞擊地球並對人類造成嚴重後果。

cues.text: How exactly do they work?
cues.en: How exactly do they work?
cues.zh: 它們如何影響的？

cues.text: How bad could they be?
cues.en: How bad could they be?
cues.zh: 他們會造成多糟的後果？

cues.text: And can we prepare for them?
cues.en: And can we prepare for them?
cues.zh: 而我們能為此做準備嗎？

cues.text: While the Sun seems pretty solid, it's actually like a very hot ocean.
cues.en: While the Sun seems pretty solid, it's actually like a very hot ocean.
cues.zh: 雖然太陽看上去很堅實， 但實際上就像是一個非常炎熱的海洋。

cues.text: So hot that it rips atoms into electrons and nuclei, all flowing around each other in a plasma.
cues.en: So hot that it rips atoms into electrons and nuclei, all flowing around each other in a plasma.
cues.zh: 熱到以至於把原子撕成電子和原子核， 而它們在電漿體中相互圍繞流動。

cues.text: This plasma is pushed around and shaped by the Sun's magnetic field.
cues.en: This plasma is pushed around and shaped by the Sun's magnetic field.
cues.zh: 這些電漿體被太陽的磁場推動並成形。

cues.text: Similar to how the Sun's gravitational field reaches out to the planets and shapes their orbits.
cues.en: Similar to how the Sun's gravitational field reaches out to the planets and shapes their orbits.
cues.zh: 類似於太陽的引力場牽制行星並塑造其軌道的方式。

cues.text: But magnetism is very different from gravity.
cues.en: But magnetism is very different from gravity.
cues.zh: 但是磁力與重力有很大的不同。

cues.text: Magnetism is one part of a dual force: Electromagnetism.
cues.en: Magnetism is one part of a dual force: Electromagnetism.
cues.zh: 磁性是雙重力的一部分：電磁。

cues.text: Electricity creates magnetic fields, and magnetic fields create electricity.
cues.en: Electricity creates magnetic fields, and magnetic fields create electricity.
cues.zh: 電產生磁場，而磁場又產生電。

cues.text: On the Sun, the plasma—made of electrically charged protons and electrons—
cues.en: On the Sun, the plasma—made of electrically charged protons and electrons—
cues.zh: 太陽是由帶電的質子和電子組成的電漿體。 它們移動時會產生磁場，

cues.text: creates a magnetic field as they move, and this magnetic field then shapes the flow of particles.
cues.en: creates a magnetic field as they move, and this magnetic field then shapes the flow of particles.
cues.zh: 它們移動時會產生磁場， 然後該磁場會影響粒子的流動。

cues.text: They're stuck in a dynamic feedback loop called a dynamo,
cues.en: They're stuck in a dynamic feedback loop called a dynamo,
cues.zh: 它們被困在稱為發電機的動態回饋迴路中，

cues.text: which keeps the sun's magnetic field alive.
cues.en: which keeps the sun's magnetic field alive.
cues.zh: 該迴路使太陽的磁場保持活躍。

cues.text: This magnetic field stores enormous amounts of energy
cues.en: This magnetic field stores enormous amounts of energy
cues.zh: 該磁場儲存大量能量，

cues.text: and leaks out over the Solar System.
cues.en: and leaks out over the Solar System.
cues.zh: 並透過太陽系洩漏出去。

cues.text: It carries with it a constant trickle of solar plasma, like a light rain, known as the solar wind,
cues.en: It carries with it a constant trickle of solar plasma, like a light rain, known as the solar wind,
cues.zh: 它伴隨著不止息的太陽電漿流， 像是雨一樣，被稱為太陽風，

cues.text: creating a sort of space weather.
cues.en: creating a sort of space weather.
cues.zh: 產生了某種太空天氣。

cues.text: But it isn't always calm and smooth.
cues.en: But it isn't always calm and smooth.
cues.zh: 但它並不總是那麼平靜且和平。

cues.text: As the sun's plasma churns and flows around itself, its magnetic field gets all kinked and twisted.
cues.en: As the sun's plasma churns and flows around itself, its magnetic field gets all kinked and twisted.
cues.zh: 當太陽的電漿體在其周圍擺動並流動時， 其磁場將會全部扭結並扭曲。

cues.text: This creates magnetic knots that build up enormous amounts of energy.
cues.en: This creates magnetic knots that build up enormous amounts of energy.
cues.zh: 這會產生積聚巨大能量的磁結。

cues.text: When the magnetic knots break—like a tangle of springs exploding outwards—
cues.en: When the magnetic knots break—like a tangle of springs exploding outwards—
cues.zh: 當磁結破裂時（如一團彈簧向外爆炸），

cues.text: the Sun can vomit plasma and other awful things into the Solar System.
cues.en: the Sun can vomit plasma and other awful things into the Solar System.
cues.zh: 太陽將把電漿和其他可怕的物質釋放進太陽系。

cues.text: These solar storms come in many types, like solar flares; a tidal wave of high-energy radiation.
cues.en: These solar storms come in many types, like solar flares; a tidal wave of high-energy radiation.
cues.zh: 這些太陽風暴有多種型別， 例如太陽耀斑；高能輻射的潮汐波。

cues.text: They race through the solar system at the speed of light, sweeping up protons in the solar wind,
cues.en: They race through the solar system at the speed of light, sweeping up protons in the solar wind,
cues.zh: 它們以光速在太陽系中蔓延， 在太陽風的帶領下掃起質子，

cues.text: accelerating them into a high-speed solar-proton storm.
cues.en: accelerating them into a high-speed solar-proton storm.
cues.zh: 從而加速了質子風暴。

cues.text: Then, there are coronal mass ejections, which rip millions or billions of tons of plasma from the Sun's atmosphere,
cues.en: Then, there are coronal mass ejections, which rip millions or billions of tons of plasma from the Sun's atmosphere,
cues.zh: 然後，有大量的物質噴出， 從太陽的大氣中逸出數百萬或數十億噸的電漿體，

cues.text: catapulting it through the solar system at speeds of up to 9 million km/h.
cues.en: catapulting it through the solar system at speeds of up to 9 million km/h.
cues.zh: 以高達900萬公里/小時的速度將其催化透過太陽系。

cues.text: When these monsters hit us, nothing happens on Earth.
cues.en: When these monsters hit us, nothing happens on Earth.
cues.zh: 當這些怪物襲擊我們時，地球上則會安然無事

cues.text: While even smaller storms can damage satellites, affect radio communication,
cues.en: While even smaller storms can damage satellites, affect radio communication,
cues.zh: 雖然減弱的風暴可能會損壞衛星， 影響無線電通訊

cues.text: or be dangerous to astronauts, for people on the surface, space weather is harmless.
cues.en: or be dangerous to astronauts, for people on the surface, space weather is harmless.
cues.zh: 或對宇航員造成危險，但對於地面人員而言，太空天氣是無害的。 但對於地面人員而言，太空天氣是無害的。

cues.text: Earth's atmosphere protects us from the worst effects of a solar flare
cues.en: Earth's atmosphere protects us from the worst effects of a solar flare
cues.zh: 地球大氣保護我們免受太陽風最嚴重的影響，

cues.text: by absorbing the blast of X-rays high up in the atmosphere, well before it reaches the surface.
cues.en: by absorbing the blast of X-rays high up in the atmosphere, well before it reaches the surface.
cues.zh: 地球大氣保護我們免受太陽風最嚴重的影響， 藉由吸收來自太陽的太陽風和X射線， 從而保護了我們。

cues.text: The electrified plasma from a CME is deflected by the Earth's magnetic field,
cues.en: The electrified plasma from a CME is deflected by the Earth's magnetic field,
cues.zh: 來自CME的帶電電漿體被地球磁場偏轉，

cues.text: diverting the energy storm to the North and South Poles, where energetic particles fall into the atmosphere,
cues.en: diverting the energy storm to the North and South Poles, where energetic particles fall into the atmosphere,
cues.zh: 將能量風暴轉移到南北兩極， 在那裡充滿能量的粒子墜入大氣，

cues.text: causing the atmosphere to glow and creating beautiful auroras.
cues.en: causing the atmosphere to glow and creating beautiful auroras.
cues.zh: 使大氣層發光並形成美麗的極光。

cues.text: As with any sort of weather— most of the time, things are fine.
cues.en: As with any sort of weather— most of the time, things are fine.
cues.zh: 與任何天氣一樣，大多數時候情況都很好。

cues.text: Sometimes, there are hurricanes, though.
cues.en: Sometimes, there are hurricanes, though.
cues.zh: 但有時候，那裡會有不尋常的風暴。

cues.text: Or in the case of the Sun, solar superstorms.
cues.en: Or in the case of the Sun, solar superstorms.
cues.zh: 或者在某些情況下，會有太陽風暴。

cues.text: And we know that they happen once or twice every century.
cues.en: And we know that they happen once or twice every century.
cues.zh: 據我們所知，它每世紀會發生一次或兩次。

cues.text: If one were to happen today, we would first detect strong solar flares,
cues.en: If one were to happen today, we would first detect strong solar flares,
cues.zh: 如果今天要發生的話， 我們將首先檢測到強烈的太陽耀斑，

cues.text: a sort of flash before the much more dangerous thunder.
cues.en: a sort of flash before the much more dangerous thunder.
cues.zh: 這是在更為危險的雷聲之前的一種閃光。

cues.text: The thunder is a CME, consisting of billions of tons of hot magnetic plasma
cues.en: The thunder is a CME, consisting of billions of tons of hot magnetic plasma
cues.zh: 這些雷是CME，由數十億噸的熱磁電漿體組成， 它們穿過了太陽和地球之間的1.5億公里，

cues.text: that crosses the 150 million kilometers between the Sun and Earth
cues.en: that crosses the 150 million kilometers between the Sun and Earth
cues.zh: 它們穿過了太陽和地球之間的1.5億公里，

cues.text: in less than a day.
cues.en: in less than a day.
cues.zh: 在不到一天的時間內。

cues.text: When it arrives, it causes a shockwave that violently compresses the Earth's magnetic field
cues.en: When it arrives, it causes a shockwave that violently compresses the Earth's magnetic field
cues.zh: 當它到達時， 它會產生衝擊波，猛烈地壓縮地球的磁場， 並將能量轉移到磁層中。

cues.text: and transfers energy into the magnetosphere.
cues.en: and transfers energy into the magnetosphere.
cues.zh: 並將能量轉移到磁層中。

cues.text: But it can get worse.
cues.en: But it can get worse.
cues.zh: 但這可能會變得更糟。

cues.text: If the magnetic field of the CME is aligned to Earth's in just the right way,
cues.en: If the magnetic field of the CME is aligned to Earth's in just the right way,
cues.zh: 如果CME的磁場以正確的方式與地球對齊，

cues.text: the two magnetic fields merge.
cues.en: the two magnetic fields merge.
cues.zh: 則這兩個磁場會合併。

cues.text: As the magnetic cloud passes over Earth, it stretches the Earth's field into a long tail.
cues.en: As the magnetic cloud passes over Earth, it stretches the Earth's field into a long tail.
cues.zh: 磁性雲層經過地球時，將地球磁場伸展成一條長長的尾巴。

cues.text: Eventually, the energy stored in the tail becomes too much to contain.
cues.en: Eventually, the energy stored in the tail becomes too much to contain.
cues.zh: 最終，儲存在尾巴中的能量將變得無法容納。

cues.text: It snaps and explosively releases its energy towards Earth.
cues.en: It snaps and explosively releases its energy towards Earth.
cues.zh: 它被扯斷並爆炸性地向地球釋放能量。

cues.text: A geomagnetic storm has begun.
cues.en: A geomagnetic storm has begun.
cues.zh: 地磁風暴已經開始了。

cues.text: A few hundred years ago, nobody would have cared.
cues.en: A few hundred years ago, nobody would have cared.
cues.zh: 幾百年前，沒有人會在意。

cues.text: This storm gushing over the Earth is not relevant for machines made out of meat and bones.
cues.en: This storm gushing over the Earth is not relevant for machines made out of meat and bones.
cues.zh: 這場席捲地球的風暴與由肉和骨頭製成的我們無關。

cues.text: But it's very relevant for machines made out of metal and wire.
cues.en: But it's very relevant for machines made out of metal and wire.
cues.zh: 但這對於由金屬和金屬絲製成的機器非常重要。

cues.text: Remember the dynamo?
cues.en: Remember the dynamo?
cues.zh: 還記得發電機嗎？

cues.text: Magnetism creates electric currents.
cues.en: Magnetism creates electric currents.
cues.zh: 磁場產生電流。

cues.text: Earth in the 21st century is covered in millions of kilometers of wires, transporting electricity,
cues.en: Earth in the 21st century is covered in millions of kilometers of wires, transporting electricity,
cues.zh: 21世紀的地球覆蓋著數百萬公里的電線， 用於運輸電力，

cues.text: and a complex grid of machines, like transformers, that make this transfer possible.
cues.en: and a complex grid of machines, like transformers, that make this transfer possible.
cues.zh: 以及復雜的機器網格，例如變壓器，使這種傳輸成為可能。

cues.text: A CME's energy can induce currents in our power grid that can either completely shut it down,
cues.en: A CME's energy can induce currents in our power grid that can either completely shut it down,
cues.zh: CME的能量可能會在我們的電網中感應出電流，這可能會完全關閉它，

cues.text: or worse, destroy the transformer stations that keep our grid running.
cues.en: or worse, destroy the transformer stations that keep our grid running.
cues.zh: 或者更糟的是，破壞我們正在執行的電網和變電站。

cues.text: This has happened already, like when the Quebec power grid failed after a strong solar storm in 1989.
cues.en: This has happened already, like when the Quebec power grid failed after a strong solar storm in 1989.
cues.zh: 這已經發生過了， 例如當1989年強烈的太陽風暴襲擊時，魁北克的電網就因此發生故障時。

cues.text: But in general, our engineers know how to deal with these storms, and so we usually don't even notice.
cues.en: But in general, our engineers know how to deal with these storms, and so we usually don't even notice.
cues.zh: 但整體來說，我們的工程師知道如何應對這些風暴， 以至於我們通常不會注意到。

cues.text: The last time a solar hurricane washed over Earth was in 1859:
cues.en: The last time a solar hurricane washed over Earth was in 1859:
cues.zh: 上一次太陽颶風襲擊地球是在1859年：

cues.text: The Carrington Event, the largest geomagnetic storms ever observed on Earth.
cues.en: The Carrington Event, the largest geomagnetic storms ever observed on Earth.
cues.zh: 卡靈頓事件， 這是地球上有史以來最大的地磁風暴。

cues.text: Massive auroras occurred as far south as the Caribbean.
cues.en: Massive auroras occurred as far south as the Caribbean.
cues.zh: 巨大的極光發生在南端的加勒比海。

cues.text: In some places, they were so bright that people got up, thinking the Sun was rising.
cues.en: In some places, they were so bright that people got up, thinking the Sun was rising.
cues.zh: 在某些地方，它們是如此明亮，以至於人們起床， 以為太陽升起了。

cues.text: Luckily, we only had one sort of modern technology: telegraph systems.
cues.en: Luckily, we only had one sort of modern technology: telegraph systems.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，我們只有一種因此被淘汰技術： 電報系統。

cues.text: They failed all over the world, shocking their operators and chucking out sparks.
cues.en: They failed all over the world, shocking their operators and chucking out sparks.
cues.zh: 他們在世界各地都失敗， 這震驚了他們的運營商，並解決這個問題。

cues.text: Today, we have a tad more technology, and our luck may run out soon.
cues.en: Today, we have a tad more technology, and our luck may run out soon.
cues.zh: 今天，我們有了更多的技術， 而我們的運氣可能很快就會耗盡。

cues.text: Another bad solar storm is bound to happen eventually.
cues.en: Another bad solar storm is bound to happen eventually.
cues.zh: 之後必然會發生另一場惡劣的太陽風暴。

cues.text: A storm as strong as the Carrington Event missed earth only by a small margin in 2012.
cues.en: A storm as strong as the Carrington Event missed earth only by a small margin in 2012.
cues.zh: 在2012年，像卡林頓賽事一樣強烈的風暴僅使地球失之交臂。

cues.text: Studies projected that it would've inflicted serious damage to electronic systems globally,
cues.en: Studies projected that it would've inflicted serious damage to electronic systems globally,
cues.zh: 研究預計，它將對全球的電子系統造成嚴重損害，

cues.text: costing up to $2.6 trillion to the US alone.
cues.en: costing up to $2.6 trillion to the US alone.
cues.zh: 單美國一項就損失高達2.6萬億美元。

cues.text: The time to replace all the damaged systems was estimated at between 4 and 10 years.
cues.en: The time to replace all the damaged systems was estimated at between 4 and 10 years.
cues.zh: 更換所有受損系統的時間估計為4至10年。

cues.text: It's hard to say how bad it could have been.
cues.en: It's hard to say how bad it could have been.
cues.zh: 很難說這會有多糟。

cues.text: Experts disagreed.
cues.en: Experts disagreed.
cues.zh: 因為有些專家意見不同

cues.text: Some assumed there would just be temporary blackouts, but others worried it could be much worse.
cues.en: Some assumed there would just be temporary blackouts, but others worried it could be much worse.
cues.zh: 有些人認為只會造成臨時停電， 但其他人則擔心情況可能會更糟。

cues.text: We won't know for sure until a big solar hurricane hits us.
cues.en: We won't know for sure until a big solar hurricane hits us.
cues.zh: 在風暴襲擊我們之前，我們無法確定。

cues.text: The probability of such an event is estimated to be 12% per decade.
cues.en: The probability of such an event is estimated to be 12% per decade.
cues.zh: 此類事件的機率估計為每十年 12％

cues.text: That's about a 50/50 chance of at least one in the next 50 years.
cues.en: That's about a 50/50 chance of at least one in the next 50 years.
cues.zh: 在接下來的50年中，至少有50%的機會。

cues.text: And, there is more unsettling news.
cues.en: And, there is more unsettling news.
cues.zh: 然而有更多另人不安的訊息

cues.text: A 2019 paper found that even calm stars, like our Sun,
cues.en: A 2019 paper found that even calm stars, like our Sun,
cues.zh: 一篇2019年的論文發現，就算是太陽這樣平靜的星星

cues.text: can create superflares every few thousand years.
cues.en: can create superflares every few thousand years.
cues.zh: 在每幾千年就可以產生出一次超級閃焰

cues.text: Eruptions orders of magnitude stronger than the strongest storms we have observed in the Solar System.
cues.en: Eruptions orders of magnitude stronger than the strongest storms we have observed in the Solar System.
cues.zh: 噴發出比目前太陽風暴還要更強的風暴 我們已經在太陽系中觀查到了

cues.text: If such a storm hits us unprepared, the consequences could be catastrophic.
cues.en: If such a storm hits us unprepared, the consequences could be catastrophic.
cues.zh: 如果這樣的風暴在我們搞不好備好的時候來襲 後果是災難性的

cues.text: It's hard to overstate how much we depend on electricity.
cues.en: It's hard to overstate how much we depend on electricity.
cues.zh: 這不是誇大我們對電力的依賴

cues.text: It's not just the lights at home.
cues.en: It's not just the lights at home.
cues.zh: 那不只是在家裡的燈炮

cues.text: It means no computers, no communication, no navigation.
cues.en: It means no computers, no communication, no navigation.
cues.zh: 意味著失去電腦運作 通訊裝置失效 導航系統無法運作

cues.text: A sustained power outage might lead to a breakdown of the supply chain,
cues.en: A sustained power outage might lead to a breakdown of the supply chain,
cues.zh: 持續性的停電可能打破我們的供應鍊

cues.text: water supply systems failing and hospital generators running dry,
cues.en: water supply systems failing and hospital generators running dry,
cues.zh: 供水系統失效 醫院的發電機燃料會用完

cues.text: supermarkets not being refilled while food rots in the fields.
cues.en: supermarkets not being refilled while food rots in the fields.
cues.zh: 超市無法補充貨物 食物在農田裡腐爛

cues.text: The lack of power might make it extremely hard to reboot our broken power grid,
cues.en: The lack of power might make it extremely hard to reboot our broken power grid,
cues.zh: 電力不足使我們在重啟殘破的電力網路時格外困難

cues.text: taking years or decades to restart our starving civilization.
cues.en: taking years or decades to restart our starving civilization.
cues.zh: 需要數年或數十年才重啟停滯很久的文明

cues.text: Okay, time to panic?
cues.en: Okay, time to panic?
cues.zh: 好的 該是驚慌了？

cues.text: As much as daily newspapers might like for solar storms to send us back to the Stone Age,
cues.en: As much as daily newspapers might like for solar storms to send us back to the Stone Age,
cues.zh: 許多新聞報紙表示太陽風暴會把我們送回石器時代

cues.text: they probably won't.
cues.en: they probably won't.
cues.zh: 其實並不會

cues.text: Fortunately, even though solar storms aren't preventable, virtually all of their nasty side effects are.
cues.en: Fortunately, even though solar storms aren't preventable, virtually all of their nasty side effects are.
cues.zh: 幸運的是，即使無法預防太陽風暴 但他的副作用是可以避免的

cues.text: Scientists observing the Sun have a few hours up to a few days to see a CME coming.
cues.en: Scientists observing the Sun have a few hours up to a few days to see a CME coming.
cues.zh: 科學家們觀察到CME從太陽過來需要小時到數天的時間

cues.text: And the engineers working the systems that keep the world running are well aware of the risks posed by solar storms.
cues.en: And the engineers working the systems that keep the world running are well aware of the risks posed by solar storms.
cues.zh: 工程師保持系統工作讓世界繼續運作 非常瞭解太陽風暴帶來的風險

cues.text: Transformers and substations can be taken offline— short preventative blackouts—
cues.en: Transformers and substations can be taken offline— short preventative blackouts—
cues.zh: 變電器與變電所可以切換成切斷 短暫的預防性停電

cues.text: or in other words, by unplugging stuff.
cues.en: or in other words, by unplugging stuff.
cues.zh: 換句話說，就像是拔掉插頭

cues.text: Engineers can open up extra lines to dissipate the extra power.
cues.en: Engineers can open up extra lines to dissipate the extra power.
cues.zh: 工程師可以開啟額外的線路使多餘的電力消散

cues.text: And with investment and upgrades cheap compared to those other natural disasters require,
cues.en: And with investment and upgrades cheap compared to those other natural disasters require,
cues.zh: 與其他自然災害相比，透過廉價的投資和升級，

cues.text: we could protect the world's electric grid against even the nastiest of storms.
cues.en: we could protect the world's electric grid against even the nastiest of storms.
cues.zh: 我們可以保護全世界的電網，甚至抵禦最惡劣的風暴。

cues.text: But we do need to prepare.
cues.en: But we do need to prepare.
cues.zh: 但我們需要準備

cues.text: While the risk is manageable, it is real.
cues.en: While the risk is manageable, it is real.
cues.zh: 僅管風險是可以控制的，但它是真實存在的

cues.text: For while our Sun bathes us in warm and pleasant light, one day, it might send a monster our way
cues.en: For while our Sun bathes us in warm and pleasant light, one day, it might send a monster our way
cues.zh: 當我們沐浴在溫暖宜人的陽光下時 也許有一天，它可能對著我們送出一頭怪物 我們最好有所準備

cues.text: that we better be ready for.
cues.en: that we better be ready for.
cues.zh: 我們最好有所準備
